description_en: Call the DescribeCrTemplates operation to query YAML templates for Istio resources that are used in common scenarios in a service mesh
description_zh: 调用DescribeCrTemplates查询服务网格中常见使用场景下的Istio资源YAML模板
kebab_example: aliyun servicemesh describe-cr-templates --istio-version v1.18.0.160-gcc1f41cd-aliyun --kind VirtualService --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCrTemplates

parameters.help_en: The Istio version that the service mesh uses
parameters.name: istio_version

parameters.help_en:
The type of Istio resource for which you want to obtain common templates. Valid values:

AuthorizationPolicy

RequestAuthentication

PeerAuthentication

WorkloadGroup

WorkloadEntry

Sidecar

EnvoyFilter

ServiceEntry

Gateway

DestinationRule

VirtualService
parameters.help_zh:
需要获取常见模板的istio资源类型，可用取值包括：

AuthorizationPolicy
RequestAuthentication
PeerAuthentication
WorkloadGroup
WorkloadEntry
Sidecar
EnvoyFilter
ServiceEntry
Gateway
DestinationRule
VirtualService
parameters.name: kind

Templates.description_en: The common YAML templates for the specified Istio resource type
Templates.description_zh: 指定Istio资源类型的资源常用YAML模板

items.description_en: A common YAML template for the specified Istio resource type
items.description_zh: 指定Istio资源类型的资源常用YAML模板

ChineseName.description_en: The Chinese name of the YAML template

EnglishName.description_en: The English name of the YAML template

Yaml.description_en: The content of the YAML template
Yaml.example:
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
  name: reviews-route # Name for this VirtualService.
spec:
  hosts:
  - reviews.prod.svc.cluster.local # Service that this VirtualSerivce belongs to. 
  http:
  - name: "reviews-route" # Name for the route.
    route:
    - destination: # Uniquely identifies the instances of a service to which all traffic should be forwarded to.
        host: reviews.prod.svc.cluster.local # The name of a service from the service registry or ServiceEntry.
        port:
          number: 8080"
